region_scene_page.compact: The art-prog road where rock becomes long-form, conceptual, technical, theatrical, and album-centered.
region_scene_page.standard: Progressive rock grows from late-1960s art ambition into 1970s album culture. Pink Floyd, Yes, Genesis, King Crimson, Emerson Lake & Palmer, Rush, and related artists treat the LP as a constructed world and the band as a technical ensemble. The pleasure is often in development rather than immediate release. A riff, theme, or keyboard figure may transform over several minutes.
